# Actowiz Solutions

> > Actowiz Solutions provides enterprise web scraping services, product data extraction, and price intelligence solutions for ecommerce, retail, and recruitment across global markets.

Actowiz Solutions specializes in no-code data scraping tools and custom extraction services for major platforms including eBay, Amazon, LinkedIn, Facebook Marketplace, and regional retailers. The company serves Fortune 500 clients with AI-powered solutions for competitive intelligence, assortment planning, and real-time price monitoring across USA, UK, UAE, India, Singapore, and other markets.

## Key Topics

- Web Scraping Services
- Product Data Extraction
- Ecommerce Scraping
- Price Monitoring & Intelligence
- Competitor Monitoring
- No-Code Scraper Tools
- Job Data Extraction
- Retail Analytics
- Assortment Planning
- Real-time Pricing Data
- Data Privacy & Security
- Multi-region Coverage (USA, UK, UAE, India, Singapore)
- Fortune 500 Enterprise Solutions
- Actowiz Metrics Platform
